_comment: Skills from other projects that pair well with this kit. They are NOT vendored.
Vendoring would mean carrying someone else's licence obligations, re-merging by hand
every time they ship a fix, and growing this repo by megabytes for files most users
never open. `node scripts/install-skills.mjs <id>` fetches one on demand instead, and
records where it came from in a NOTICE.md beside it.
The kit's own skills live in skills/<name>/SKILL.md and are always present.
Adding an entry: `licenseFile` is required. The installer refuses to install a skill
whose upstream has no licence file, because a skill with no licence is a skill nobody
is legally allowed to reuse — the same reason RAG-EVAL-VN needed one.

seo.summary: Audits and fixes on-page SEO: meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt.
seo.why: Markdown only — no API keys, no MCP server, no subscription. Everything it does, it does by reading and editing files, which is why it fits a kit that installs nothing.

taste.summary: Design judgement for generated interfaces — layout, type, spacing, motion.
taste.why: Video templates in this kit are HTML and CSS, so the same judgement applies to a 9:16 frame as to a web page.

imagegen-web.summary: Prompts for generating design comps and interface imagery.
imagegen-web.why: For the cover and in-frame images a post or video needs, when a stock search returns nothing usable.

brandkit.summary: Builds a consistent brand kit — palette, type scale, logo direction.
brandkit.why: Feeds the theme system: a palette decided once becomes a `theme` entry every template reads.
